cards.short_summary: A named Regis programming tradition overseen through student-government activity leadership.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis University’s student-government constitution lists Ranger Day among the on-campus programming and activities led by its vice president of programming.
cards.source_title: Constitution of the Regis University Student Government Association
cards.access_notes: Event timing and activities are not specified in the constitution; consult current Student Activities communications.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Regis University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend sequence for getting oriented, meeting people and trying campus spaces.

cards.title: Start on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Boettcher Commons, Northwest Denver Campus
cards.notes: Use the campus hub as your first meeting point, then take a slow lap to identify the Student Center, chapel and nearby paths.
cards.short_summary: A simple starting point for getting your bearings.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis identifies Boettcher Commons, also called the Quad, as the hub of its Northwest Denver campus.
cards.source_title: SOAR: Starting Out at Regis
cards.access_notes: Campus events and access may vary; check Regis event information before attending a scheduled program.

cards.title: Claim a Library Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Dayton Memorial Library, Northwest Denver Campus
cards.notes: Walk through the library early, choose a group or individual study area, and save the research-help contact for your first assignment.
cards.short_summary: Locate study space and academic support before classes begin.
cards.evidence_claim: Dayton Memorial Library provides group and individual study areas, research assistance and access to books, articles and databases.
cards.source_title: Dayton Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Library services and room access may have eligibility or scheduling requirements.

cards.title: Have a Campus Breakfast
cards.subtitle: The Table, Student Center
cards.notes: Meet a new hallmate for a meal and use the Student Center as a landmark before moving on to afternoon orientation activities.
cards.short_summary: An easy meal stop inside the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Table at Regis is in the Student Center and offers an all-you-care-to-eat dining experience.
cards.source_title: Regis Campus Dining
cards.access_notes: Dining access and payment options depend on current campus dining arrangements.

cards.entity_name: Walk Your Schedule with a SOAR Leader
cards.title: Walk Your Class Schedule
cards.subtitle: Begins at Boettcher Commons during SOAR
cards.notes: Join the scheduled walkthrough if available, or retrace your own routes from the Quad so Monday’s classrooms feel familiar.
cards.short_summary: Turn a campus map into a practical first-day route.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis’s 2026 orientation schedule lists a guided “Walk Your Schedule with a SOAR Leader” beginning at Boettcher Commons.
cards.source_title: Student Orientation Schedule
cards.access_notes: This is scheduled orientation programming; confirm the current orientation schedule and eligibility.

cards.title: Pause at the Chapel
cards.subtitle: St. John Francis Regis Chapel, Northwest Denver Campus
cards.notes: Add the chapel to your campus walk and check University Ministry’s current calendar if you want to attend a service or reflection.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landmark for a quieter stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis lists St. John Francis Regis Chapel on its Northwest Denver campus map and directions page.
cards.source_title: Campus Map and Directions
cards.access_notes: Services and building access follow the current University Ministry and campus schedule.

cards.title: Try the Back 9
cards.subtitle: East side of the Northwest Denver Campus
cards.notes: Bring or borrow a disc if available, then play a casual loop with new friends and yield to other users on the compact course.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation option for a low-pressure group activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis describes the Back 9 as a compact disc golf course on the east side of campus, open to the university community and neighbors.
cards.source_title: Recreational Sports
cards.access_notes: Bring appropriate equipment and follow current course and campus-use guidance.

cards.title: Find the Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: O'Sullivan Art Gallery, Northwest Denver Campus
cards.notes: Locate the gallery while touring campus, then check the University calendar or gallery information for the current exhibition and visitor details.
cards.short_summary: A named arts destination to add to your campus mental map.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis’s Northwest Denver Campus map lists O'Sullivan Art Gallery as a campus destination.
cards.source_title: Northwest Denver Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Exhibition hours and visitor access are not stated on the campus map; verify before going.

cards.title: See the Field House
cards.subtitle: Regis Field House, Northwest Denver Campus
cards.notes: Find the Field House and nearby fields so you know where intramurals, athletics and orientation gatherings may take place.
cards.short_summary: A practical athletics-and-recreation landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The Regis Field House supports intramural and intercollegiate sports and includes a gymnasium, handball courts, steam room and weight room for students.
cards.source_title: Regis University Academic Catalog: Academic Integrity Policy
cards.access_notes: Facility use is for students and may be subject to recreation schedules and access rules.

cards.title: Check Out the Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: Coors Life Directions Center 118D
cards.notes: Ask Outdoor Adventure Program staff about current wall access, introductory events and shoe checkout before trying a climb with a partner.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus activity to explore with current guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Regis states that its climbing wall is available when the fitness center is open and hosts introductory and community climbing events; shoes are available to rent free.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Adventure Program
cards.access_notes: Use the wall only when the fitness center is open; confirm current facility hours and event details with the Outdoor Adventure Program.

cards.entity_name: Regis Outdoor Adventure Program Gear Rentals
cards.title: Plan a Future Colorado Day
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Adventure Program, Coors Life Directions Center 118D
cards.notes: Browse the available gear and ask staff how to reserve it; a future day hike or picnic can be an easy next-weekend plan.
cards.short_summary: Set up a future outdoor outing through a student resource.
cards.evidence_claim: The Outdoor Adventure Program offers free gear rentals to current Regis students with a valid ID, for up to two business days.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Adventure Program
cards.access_notes: Available to current Regis students with valid ID; submit requests and confirm pickup details with the Outdoor Adventure Program.
